items.source_ref: Main exact-point and MPS sections; Supplement MPS and direct-product sections
items.scientific_object: At theta=pi/4 the periodic chain is frustration free, has 2^N+1 ground states, and admits the stated bond-dimension-four MPS sector construction.
items.authored_reason: Independent projector, sector-nullity, MPS-zero-mode, and uniform-minus symmetric-combination checks cover this central analytic family.

items.item_id: Claim: periodic phase and product-state controls
items.source_ref: Main phase-diagram section and Supplement purely biquadratic model
items.scientific_object: For periodic boundaries, the two Cartesian product states give the zero-energy doubly-degenerate phase, the uniform-z state is the unique theta=3pi/2 ground state with energy -N, and the phase diagram has the stated mirror symmetry.
items.authored_reason: Independent product-state energies and representative sector spectra cover the periodic-chain phase-control family.

items.source_ref: Supplement section Edge states and Fig. S1
items.scientific_object: For even N with open boundaries and X bonds at both ends, dim ker H(theta=pi/4)=2^(N+1)-1.
items.authored_reason: The supplement supplies the claim and an N=2 rank argument, but no accepted independent open-chain count is registered.

items.source_ref: Supplement section The purely biquadratic model, theta=pi/2
items.scientific_object: For open boundaries at theta=pi/2, the zero-energy ground-state degeneracy equals 2N+1.
items.authored_reason: The current implementation and accepted evidence are periodic-boundary only; no open-chain nullity sequence is registered.

items.item_id: Claim: open-chain theta=3pi/2 energy and degeneracy
items.source_ref: Supplement section The purely biquadratic model, theta=3pi/2
items.scientific_object: For even open chains at theta=3pi/2, four product ground states have energy -(N-1) and independently selectable edge conserved quantities.
items.authored_reason: The accepted phase controls check only periodic boundaries; no open-chain energy/nullity artifact is registered.

items.source_ref: Supplement section Fractionalized variational ansatz for theta<pi/4
items.scientific_object: In the uniform-positive-w theta=0 ground-state expansion, the number of triplet-x states on X bonds and triplet-y states on Y bonds is even.
items.authored_reason: No accepted coefficient-support or global-rotation check currently verifies the parity selection rule.

items.item_id: Claim: perturbation preserves the uniform-positive-w sector
items.source_ref: Supplement section Bond conserved quantities in the phase with the unique ground state
items.scientific_object: Bilinear perturbation around theta=3pi/2 has no first-order energy shift, starts at second order, and remains in the uniform-positive-w sector at every perturbative order.
items.authored_reason: The periodic phase sample does not constitute an independent perturbative-order or matrix-element check.
